approach: Create docs/spec.toml ([[requirement]] and [[open_question]] tables, each with verbatim sourced quotes) and xtask/tests/spec.rs with a pure check(spec, brief) -> Vec<String>. Tests: real spec passes; four negative cases that each assert the specific planted cause string and that the unmutated spec yields none; coverage by source heading; schema; open questions; and a new direct boundary-word test that reads docs/spec.toml from disk (not via git ls-files) and checks it against athena_context::briefs::boundary_words()/boundary_fragments() with whole-word case-insensitive regex, plus an in-memory negative planting a banned word. Then D111, CHANGELOG, enforcement row, ontology term. 2A and the 'operator is the brain' addendum are explicitly excluded.

decisions.choice: TOML with [[requirement]] and [[open_question]] tables, parsed by the existing toml dev-dependency
decisions.reason: Repo already uses TOML data (ontology.toml); maintained crate present (buy-first); multi-line quotes and nested sources are easy to check.

rejected.why: Needs a hand-written parser; fragile extraction.
No comments, awkward multi-line text, noisy diffs for a document Sri approves.
Implicit typing and less-maintained crates; policy treats YAML as an exception.

decisions.choice: Source heading is the exact BRIEF.md heading text; addenda items use '<heading> › <label>' (e.g. 3C). The checker requires the part before ' › ' to be a real heading and the quote to appear after the '# Project Olympus' line.
decisions.reason: Lets coverage count by heading and keeps quotes inside the Olympus layer.

decisions.choice: Quote check: collapse whitespace on both sides, substring containment. Quotes are chosen to stop short of M19 banned words.
decisions.reason: Matches criterion 1(a) and keeps policy passing.

rejected.option: Edit policy.rs to exempt the spec
rejected.why: Weakens a protected check; criterion 5 forbids it.

decisions.choice: Add a direct boundary test in spec.rs reading docs/spec.toml from disk and using athena_context::briefs::boundary_words() and boundary_fragments() (whole-word, case-insensitive regex, same as policy.rs), with an in-memory negative planting a banned word; name it in the enforcement row. policy.rs unchanged.
decisions.reason: policy.rs M19 uses git ls-files so it skips an untracked spec; the direct test checks criterion 5 in any environment (answers finding 1).

rejected.why: Passes vacuously while the file is untracked.

decisions.choice: 2A and the 'The operator is the brain for now' addendum get no requirement and no quote; the spec header comment and D111 say they are excluded as owner-side/out of scope.
decisions.reason: They concern who runs Athena or where; criterion 5 and the out-of-scope list forbid such statements, and quoting around them is a workaround (finding 2).

decisions.choice: Negative tests assert a specific problem string (e.g. 'duplicate id OLY-001', 'supersedes OLY-999 not found', 'no sources', 'quote not found') and that the unmutated spec yields none in the same test.
decisions.reason: A non-empty check could pass for unrelated reasons (finding 3).

decisions.choice: Open questions need ≥2 sources, both after '# Project Olympus'. Pair candidates from the Olympus layer only: addenda 'reconsider its own design every few jobs' against a stable-design/governed self-modification line in R5, or 5A 'No formal ontology for now'. Producer re-reads BRIEF.md and picks a pair whose quotes exist; no resolution field.

rejected.option: Pair with the API-surface line and earlier Athena-brief text

decisions.choice: Add ontology term 'spec' with misread, sources docs/spec.toml and D111.
decisions.reason: Listed deliverable; 'spec' is confusable with the Athena brief and design docs.

files.purpose: Olympus requirements layer with sourced verbatim quotes and open questions.
Checker and tests: real spec, negatives, coverage, schema, open questions, boundary-word test.
Unreleased/Added entry for the spec and checker.
Append D111: format, TOML choice, alternatives, exclusions, provenance.
New M row naming real tests in spec.rs.
Only if regex or athena-context are not yet dev-dependencies; otherwise unchanged.

steps: Re-read BRIEF.md from '# Project Olympus' to end; list requirement-bearing sentences by heading; merge duplicates; mark 2A and the 'operator is the brain' addendum as excluded.
Check xtask/Cargo.toml dev-dependencies (toml, serde, regex, athena-context) and policy.rs matching logic (lines ~53–184) to reuse the same regex construction.
Write docs/spec.toml with a header comment (format, exclusions), requirements and open questions, avoiding banned words.

Write xtask/tests/spec.rs: structs, normalize, headings, check(); tests for real spec, four specific-string negatives, coverage plus negative, schema, open questions, direct boundary test plus planted-word negative.
Run cargo test -p xtask; fix quote mismatches and boundary hits.
Add D111, CHANGELOG entry, enforcement row (after last M), ontology term 'spec'.
Run cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, cargo test --locked; touch Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock only if needed.

risks.risk: Quotes or statements hit M19 banned words (Hermes row, handoffs, etc.).
risks.mitigation: Choose quotes stopping short of banned words; direct boundary test and policy.rs both run; 2A and brain addendum excluded.

risks.risk: Quote differs from BRIEF.md by a dash or bullet.
risks.mitigation: Whitespace-collapsing check; copy text exactly; avoid list markers.
Explicit key list in coverage test with negative; walk BRIEF.md Olympus sections one by one.

risks.risk: Scope creep into the Athena brief, readers or prompts.
risks.mitigation: Checker enforces quotes after the Olympus line; no crates/ changes.

risks.risk: Clippy/fmt failures in new test file.
risks.mitigation: Follow policy.rs style; run fmt, clippy and test before finishing.

demonstrations.method: Integration tests in xtask/tests/spec.rs: the real spec yields no problems; four in-memory mutations each assert a specific problem string naming the planted cause/id, and the same test asserts the unmutated spec is clean.
demonstrations.observes: All pass; mutations yield 'quote not found', 'duplicate id <id>', 'supersedes <id> not found', 'no sources' respectively.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the checker skipped whitespace-collapsed containment, id uniqueness, supersedes existence, or non-empty sources, the matching negative test would find no such string and fail.

demonstrations.method: Coverage test groups requirements by source heading (with item label for addenda) and requires ≥1 for R1–R8, Phases 1–6 and their acceptance, '10. Final system acceptance', 3C, 4A, 5A, 7A; a second case removes one group in memory and expects the missing key named.
demonstrations.observes: Passes on the real spec; the removal case reports the missing heading.
demonstrations.fails_without: A missing requirement for any required heading makes the coverage test fail naming it.

demonstrations.method: Schema test deserialises with serde deny_unknown_fields, validates kind/status enums and non-empty id/statement/sources/heading/quote; coverage also requires headings for vision, governing philosophy, sections 1–9 and the addenda. Producer's diff review checks duplicates merged into multi-source requirements.
demonstrations.observes: All requirements validate; every section heading appears among sources.
demonstrations.fails_without: A missing field, bad enum value or missing source fails the schema test; an uncovered section fails coverage.

demonstrations.method: Open-question test requires ≥1 [[open_question]], each with ≥2 sources verbatim in BRIEF.md after the Olympus line, and no resolution field.
demonstrations.observes: Passes; the question carries both quotes.
demonstrations.fails_without: No open question, fewer than two sources, or a quote not in BRIEF.md fails the test.

demonstrations.method: The new spec.rs boundary test reads docs/spec.toml directly (independent of git tracking) and checks boundary_words()/boundary_fragments(); its negative plants a banned word in an in-memory copy and expects a flag. The unchanged policy.rs tests also run.
demonstrations.observes: Boundary test and policy.rs tests pass; the planted-word case is flagged.
demonstrations.fails_without: A banned word or fragment in docs/spec.toml fails the direct boundary test even when untracked.

demonstrations.method: Run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test; includes enforcement-map and ontology checks.
demonstrations.fails_without: A format, lint or test failure gives a non-zero exit.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff for CHANGELOG.md entry, D111 in docs/decisions.md (format, TOML choice, alternatives Markdown with ids/JSON/YAML, exclusion of 2A and brain addendum), enforcement row, ontology term; confirm nothing under crates/, no prompt or reader changed.
demonstrations.observes: Only deliverable files changed; spec covers Olympus layer only.

open_questions: Exact open-question pair: producer must pick one whose quotes both exist after '# Project Olympus'.
Whether the 2026-10-18 history-exemption addendum states a standing requirement; left out unless it does.
Last M number in docs/enforcement.md; producer must find it before adding a row.
Whether regex and athena-context are already xtask dev-dependencies; policy.rs suggests yes, producer confirms.
